@everyone 

I realize times are a bit slower as we all navigate this bear market together. But guess what... that does not mean that scammers, hacks, etc also go into a "bear" phase! While the majority of the crypto space is sitting back at the moment, this provides a PRIME opportunity for scammers to catch individuals off guard...

I must send this reminder out to you all to STAY ON YOUR GUARD!!! It is very important to continue to be vigilant and remember to: 


- Turn off DMs via discord settings
- NEVER click on links, especially if sent in a DM
- Always double check any action you are about to proceed with (double check links, double check discord IDs, etc)
- IF there is a giveaway or staking opportunity presented to you, ALWAYS double check that it is real by coming to our discord and checking
- Always pay attention to emails and who they are sent by and what they are trying to have you click on (this is a high target area)
- NEVER download anything from an email, discord, twitter, or facebook
- ALWAYS be on the lookout for copycat social accounts


Lastly, I just ask you all to just be careful with every action you take in the crypto space. 

Much Love, 

Matt and the Corn Team (edited)
